bio: This stylish bar-cum-restaurant is owned by a small boutique winery and the creative dishes are designed to match their wines – some of which aren’t sold anywhere else in the world! The evening sees an à la carte menu that appeals to all, while during the day there’s a great value set lunch that’s a hit with the business community. Dishes are refined and well-presented, with a mix of local and international flavours; you might find salmon trout with blueberries and goat's cheese or Mangalitsa shoulder with butternut squash and peach. For the full experience, go for the 'Made in Hungary' chef’s menu....
